The Justice Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the amended lawsuit.

title: Perez Hilton’s family says his children ‘fled’ their home before his reported self-harm livestream
summary: The family said they “fled to protect from witnessing any further trauma” after “it became clear” that Hilton was “harming himself.”
story: Perez Hilton’s family said his three children, niece and sister were inside the home “minutes before” he publicly livestreamed what appeared to be self-harm amid “a severe mental health crisis.”
In a statement issued Thursday on Hilton’s blog, his family said they “fled to protect from witnessing any further trauma” after “it became clear” that Hilton was “harming himself.”

Hilton, 48, whose real name is Mario Lavandeira, started a livestream on his TikTok account Tuesday before the platform pulled it and his account down. In the video, he appeared to be covered in blood, with visible cuts and holding what appeared to be a knife.

The celebrity blogger is a single parent to his children, who are all under the age of 14 and born via surrogacy. Hilton’s family implored the public “to leave the area surrounding the family’s home and not return.”

“Our highest priority right now is helping the children begin to heal from what they experienced,” the statement reads. “An important part of that process is allowing them to safely return home and begin rebuilding a sense of security and normalcy.”

A spokesperson for the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office told NBC News that deputies responded to reports Tuesday night of someone “who was livestreaming acts of self-harm on social media.” The office did not name Hilton, but it said the person was “safely recovered” and taken by Miami-Dade Fire Rescue to a hospital, where he was receiving medical attention.
Hilton’s family confirmed he was receiving medical care Wednesday, saying he “is able to communicate, which has given our family hope.”

The 48-year-old was hospitalized at least two times in the months preceding this week’s incident for an ulcer, sepsis and deep vein thrombosis. In recent months, he has also told his followers that he’s found God.

Hilton rose to fame in the early 2000s blogging about celebrities’ personal lives and other entertainment news. His work has often been criticized for belittling women and invading the privacy of others.
On Thursday, his family expressed gratitude “for the overwhelming outpouring of love, support, and prayers we have received during this incredibly difficult time.”
“The events of the past several days have been nearly unbearable for our family,” the statement reads.
If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 988 or go to 988lifeline.org to reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline or visit SpeakingOfSuicide.com/resources.

title: Remains found in yard in search for missing couple, police say son may have left country
summary: The remains of two people were found in an Arizona backyard Thursday as police searched for a missing father and mother whose son is believed to have fled the country, police said.
story: The remains of two people were found in an Arizona backyard Thursday as police searched for a missing father and mother whose son is believed to have fled the country, police said.
The son, Matthew Flores, 27, was initially part of the missing persons report made by concerned family members Tuesday, Avondale police spokesperson Officer Daniel Benavidez said.
When police went to conduct a welfare check at the home in Litchfield Park they saw evidence of foul play, he said.

They identified “a large amount of blood, and we also identified what we believed as evidence in an attempt to conceal that blood, and that’s what made us believe that foul play is involved,” Benavidez said at a news conference Thursday.

The human remains found in the backyard had not been identified Thursday afternoon, police said. They were being recovered with the assistance of Phoenix police homicide unit when Benavidez spoke with reporters.
Family members on Tuesday afternoon called police and said they expected the mother, father and their adult son to be at the residence where the remains were later found, Benavidez said.
Police said that they believe Flores fled the country before officers conducted the welfare check Tuesday.
Police did not release the names of the parents Thursday on request from the family that reported the people missing, Benavidez said.
The bodies were found buried in the backyard and were in a state of decomposition, police said. Police did not say how long they were believed to have been there.
Police were calling Flores a suspect in the missing persons investigation Thursday, Benavidez said.
Police were looking for Flores and have leads in the case, Benavidez said. They asked anyone with information about Flores’ movements or about him to contact the department.
Benavidez did not say to which country Flores is believed to have fled. "All I can say is that he fled the country,” he said.

title: Illinois teen in clown outfit charged with murder of 78-year-old man
summary: The suspect had “the intent to kill” John Wesley Allen, 78, who was stabbed Monday at a bus stop in East St. Louis, Illinois, officials said.
story: A teenager accused of stabbing a 78-year-old man to death while dressed as a clown was charged with murder Thursday, and the prosecutor wants to try him as an adult, Illinois officials said.
John Wesley Allen was killed Monday in East St. Louis. He “was waiting at a bus stop when he was stabbed in a random attack by a suspect wearing a clown outfit,” Illinois State Police said.
The 15-year-old suspect, who was arrested after the stabbing, was charged Thursday with a count of first-degree murder, state police said in a statement.

The teenager had “the intent to kill or do great bodily harm” to Allen, who was stabbed “about the body with a knife, thereby causing” his death, according to a court filing by St. Clair County Assistant State’s Attorney Derek Smith.
The state’s attorney is seeking to prosecute the teen as an adult on a first-degree murder charge, according to the court document.
East St. Louis police were called for a report of a body in a roadway around 10 p.m. Monday and found Allen, of Jennings, Missouri, dead, state police said.
The 15-year-old was located at a residence and arrested Monday, state police said.
State police have said that video of the suspect wearing a clown costume is circulating and that they are seeking to obtain all video in the case.

Doorbell camera video obtained by NBC affiliate KSDK of St. Louis showed a person whose face was partly covered looking into the camera and saying, “I have a gift for you.” Neighbors told the station they saw a person going door to door with a large knife Monday night.
It was not immediately clear Thursday whether the teenager, who remained in custody Thursday, had a defense lawyer to speak on his behalf.
East St. Louis is across the Mississippi River from St. Louis, Missouri.

title: Kylie Kelce Shares the Moment That Made Jason So Emotional at Travis and Taylor Swift’s Wedding
summary: Kylie Kelce responded to husband Jason Kelce’s comments that he cried more at brother Travis Kelce’s wedding than his own — and there’s an extra special reason.
story: There’s a reason why Jason Kelce was extra emotional at his brother Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift’s wedding — and the answer is really sweet.
Kylie Kelce shared some insight after her husband recently shared that he “probably cried more at this wedding than I cried at my own wedding, which probably is not acceptable.”

Jason Kelce served as his brother’s best man during the star-studded July 3 wedding at Madison Square Garden. During his chat with Philadelphia radio station 94WIP in July, Jason Kelce jokingly added that wife Kylie Kelce was most likely “not happy” he cried more at this wedding than his own.
But how did Kylie Kelce really feel? She answered that very question and provided more details about the celebration on the Aug. 6 episode of her “Not Gonna Lie With Kylie Kelce” podcast.

“Don’t worry, my husband cried plenty at his own wedding, regardless of what his comments were recently,” she said, before joking about how she would have reacted if she didn’t get the reaction she wanted from her husband.

“Guys, think about this. First of all, there was a moment in time where I said if he didn’t tear up when I started walking down the aisle, I would go back and start again, knowing that someone would have obviously punched him in the nose between me restarting,” she said. “And he would have been crying when I walked down the aisle.”
On a serious note, however, she told listeners to “consider the context” of what the retired Eagles player said because there’s more to the story.
“Obviously, my husband cried during our wedding. He did,” she said. “I think that goes without being said because he’s cried a couple other places because he feels his emotions, OK.”
She continued by adding that “more importantly,” Jason Kelce cried at his brother’s wedding “for many reasons.”

“It was touching. It was very loving to see all of the things that were happening,” she said, pointing out one very specific moment during Travis Kelce and Swift’s wedding. “But take this into consideration, because no one’s thinking about this, think about getting to watch your four daughters be flower girls. OK? That’s all the information you get.”
Jason Kelce previously confirmed in an interview that his little girls — Wyatt, 6, Elliotte, 5, Bennett, 3, and Finnley, 1 — were flower girls.
“They’re beautiful, they’re incredible personalities and Travis and Taylor love them,” he told the Reno Gazette Journal.
Kylie Kelce echoed the sentiments, sharing on her podcast that it was also a sentimental moment for her.
“It was emotional and he was not the only adult crying in our family,” she said, adding that she was also “guilty.” “Mmkay? Come on. Be for real.”
She concluded her wedding talk by quipping that she has given her husband “s--- about (his comments), and yes, I will continue to, ‘cause that is my right as his wife.”

title: ‘My Life with the Walter Boys’ Season 3 Ending Explained
summary: What happens at the end of Season 3 of My Life with the Walter Boys? Read a recap of Season 3 and find out what’s next.
story: Warning: Spoilers ahead for Season 3 of “My Life with the Walter Boys.”
If you thought Season 2 of “My Life with the Walter Boys” ended with a bang, just wait until you watch Season 3.

The hit Netflix series returned with 10 new episodes Aug. 6 and continued its streak of leaving viewers on the edge of their seats with an action-packed season finale. Luckily, the show has already been renewed for Season 4.

Season 3 finds Jackie (Nikki Rodriguez) exploring her chemistry with Cole (Noah LaLonde). After starting off slow, their romance quickly heats up and they finally seem to be on the right track, especially when Alex (Ashby Gentry) begins to make peace with the end of his relationship with Jackie.

Then, a newcomer shows up in town: Eliot (Naveen Paddock), Jackie’s childhood friend from New York. Eliot represents everything from Jackie’s life before moving to Colorado — ambition, hustle culture and a fast-paced life — and her uncle Richard wants to make sure Jackie hasn’t let the slow pace of Colorado life (or her romance with notorious bad boy Cole) impact her future goals.

Later on in the season, Eliot and Richard get into Cole’s head and convince him that he’s holding Jackie back and having a negative influence on her. Worried that Jackie truly is better off without him, Cole breaks up with her in cruel fashion. Alas, he’s still in love with her, and several members of his family urge him to make things right.
All the teenage drama comes to a head in the Season 3 finale, which will leave you eagerly counting down the days until Season 4 arrives.
Jackie’s Community Center Opens

All season long, Jackie worked to create a community space for teens in Silver Falls. With one week left until the opening event, she runs into some major issues when a pipe bursts in the building, causing a bunch of damage to the space.

Jackie learns that it could take several weeks to repair, and she doesn’t want to postpone the event. However, she quickly discovers that making the repairs in a timely manner is going to be quite expensive.

When Cole hears the news, he visits Jackie’s uncle Richard and asks him if there’s anything he can do to expedite the repairs process. Richard teams up with George (Marc Blucas) and the Walter family to make sure the space is ready in time for the event. Still, Jackie is unaware that Cole had orchestrated the quick turnaround.
At the event, Alex tells Jackie that Cole spoke with Richard, offered to pay the contractors himself and enlisted help from his coworkers at the auto shop he works at to help with the repairs.

Jackie is confused and wonders why Cole would go to such lengths to help when he broke up with her. Alex tells her it’s “complicated” and Eliot interrupts their conversation before he can divulge any additional information.
Nathan Prepares to Leave Town for an Exciting Opportunity
After auditioning for a European band tour, Nathan (Corey Fogelmanis) learns that he got the spot. Even better, his parents agreed to let him go.

When Nathan tells Alex the big news, Alex notes that Nathan doesn’t seem super excited. Nathan then explains that he’s eager to do something to find out who he is and what he wants. At the same time, he’s nervous that the timing isn’t right, especially since their dad is recovering from his stroke and Will (Johnny Link) and Haley (Zoë Soul) just left town.
Alex encourages Nathan to pursue his dreams. Nathan breaks the news to his ex, Skylar (Jaylan Evans), who says he will miss him while he’s gone.
Alex Renews His Passion for Horses After Quitting the Rodeo

After earning a saddle bronc riding sponsorship in Season 2, Alex gets more involved with his team in Season 3. A lot of the guys are significantly older and they pressure him to drink and get a tattoo.

When one of the riders offers Alex pain pills to cope with the injuries they sustain while riding, Alex ends up inadvertently reporting him during a frustrating rant about the team’s complicated dynamics.

Alex ends up walking about from saddle bronc riding, but his mom Katherine (Sarah Rafferty) ends up offering him another way to connect with horses when she brings an injured wild horse back to the Walter family ranch.

While talking with George, Katherine says she figured Alex needed something to shift his attention to after stepping away from the rodeo. Plus, she doesn’t want him to leave the ranch like Nathan and Will.
Dylan Asks Alex to Stay Away from Kiley
Alex’s best friend Kiley (Mya Lowe) has always had a thing for him, but she started dating Dylan (Kolton Stewart) in Season 2 and their relationship is going strong in Season 3.

Kiley likes to keep her home life private since her grandmother has a drinking problem, so she hesitates to invite Dylan over as their relationship progresses. But when Dylan finds out that Alex regularly spends time at Kiley’s house with her grandmother, Dylan grows jealous of their friendship.

Throughout the season, Alex tagged along with the couple on several outings. Alex begins to notice his own feelings for Kiley and he kisses her one day. They both agree that it shouldn’t have happened since she’s with Dylan. Still, Alex can’t stop thinking about it and he’s worried since Kiley is avoiding him after the kiss.

In the season finale, Dylan asks Alex to keep his distance from Kiley and he agrees to do so. However, he later visits Kiley at home, seemingly to declare his feelings for her, and he’s crushed to see that she invited Dylan over, signaling that their relationship is going better than ever.
Danny Gets Into Carnegie Mellon University

Danny (Connor Stanhope) and Erin’s (Alisha Newton) relationship has been going strong in Season 3. After he drunkenly proposed to her one night, things got a bit awkward, but they later agreed that they both want to get married at some point.
In the Season 3 finale, Danny announces that he was accepted to Carnegie Mellon University. Erin is thrilled for him, especially since he was crushed when he wasn’t accepted to The Juilliard School.

Erin plans to stay in Colorado for college, so Danny is understandably concerned about attending a school across the country. However, Erin convinces him that they’ll make the whole long distance thing work.
They still have some time to figure things out, but Danny reassures Erin that his dream is being wherever Erin is.
Jackie and Eliot Kiss

Ever since Eliot arrived in Silver Falls, he’s been trying his hardest to steal Jackie from Cole. After Jackie and Cole break up, Eliot tries to make a move when Jackie asks if he wants to come to the community center opening event with him. When he asks if it’s a date, she says she’s not ready to date yet after her breakup, but he still agrees to go with her.
At the event, Jackie pulls Eliot onto the dance floor. In the last second of the season finale, he moves in for a kiss and the scene ends.
Cole Gets Into a Scary Car Accident
Cole has always been into cars, but he begins racing them in Season 3 after meeting a drag racer named Mac (Chad Rook).
In the season finale, Cole nails one of his races and is preparing for another round when he decides that he’s waited long enough to tell Jackie why he broke up with her.
Cole ends up leaving before his other race, much to the dismay of his competitor, who was relying on the race to give him the opportunity to either qualify for another race or earn some money.

Cole’s competitor follows him home and starts driving aggressively behind him. Cole does his best to keep his distance, but his rival dries him off the road and Cole’s car ends up flipping over multiple times, leaving viewers wondering if he could’ve survived the accident.

title: Tan France Responds to Karamo Brown Saying ‘Queer Eye’ Was a ‘Nightmare’
summary: Tan France shared his reaction to fellow “Queer Eye” castmate Karamo Brown’s assertion there was a toxic culture on the set of the show before its conclusion after 10 seasons earlier this year.
story: Tan France shared his reaction to fellow “Queer Eye” castmate Karamo Brown’s assertion that there was a toxic culture on the set of the show before its conclusion after 10 seasons earlier this year.

In a People magazine cover story in June titled “Surviving My Reality TV Nightmare,” Brown said he clashed with some of his costars, describing bullying from executives and production members and opened up about relapsing in 2018 during the third season of the show.
France, 43, spoke with Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones on TODAY Aug. 6 about Brown’s comments.

“First of all, I’m sad that was the experience that he felt like it was a nightmare, as I said it was a dream for me,” France said. “I couldn’t believe it. And so for me, I look back thinking, gosh, we did what I think was incredible work and had a phenomenal experience.
“I’m so proud of what we did, and all I want is for the audience to remember that. I want them to know that it was so real for me on that show. Every experience that I had was special,” he added.
The Netflix show released its 10th and final season in January. The show’s producers disputed Brown’s claims about the environment on set.

“We strongly disagree with any characterization that concerns raised during the production of ‘Queer Eye’ were ignored, dismissed or allowed to continue unchecked,” the show’s production company, ITV America and Scout Productions, told People at the time.
Brown was set to attend a Jan. 20 interview on TODAY with France and castmates Antoni Porowski, Jonathan Van Ness and Jeremiah Brent to promote the show, but he canceled last-minute.
He explained his absence in a June 23 appearance on TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle.

“One of the things that I’ve been teaching people right now is that two things can be true at once,” he said. “‘Queer Eye’ was one of the most amazing shows — the impact that it had culturally for 10 years and what we were able to do. One of the things I’ll say about my cast, no matter what we were going through, we always made sure that the hero was No. 1, that the person we were helping, the crew worked so hard.

“But on the flip side, you can also have a bad experience,” he continued. “And you can also feel as if you’re not being protected and things are not going well. So while I loved what we did, it didn’t mean that I loved what was happening to me.”
During the group interview without Brown on TODAY in January, one of his costars remarked on his absence.
“I think (we’re) definitely a little surprised, but at the same time, like, look, we’re so sorry that he’s not here,” Porowski said.
France made it clear in his Aug. 6 appearance on TODAY that he enjoyed his time on the show, which followed a “Fab Five” team of gay professionals giving lifestyle makeovers to guests.

“Now I look back thinking, gosh, we won loads of Emmys, we were nominated for an Emmy again this season, that’s wild after all those years to still feel so positively about your work,” he said. “If they wanted to do another 10 seasons, I’m like yeah, it was the greatest gift of my life.”

The British-born fashion designer also said he’s grateful to have seen so much of the U.S. thanks to his time on “Queer Eye.” He’s currently moving from Salt Lake City to New York City with his husband and two children.

“I am the luckiest man in the world,” he said. “I got to do, in my opinion, the best job in the world with some of the greatest people that you could ever meet. I got to see America through a lens that no one else really gets to.”

title: ‘Freaky Friday’ Turns 23: Watch Lindsay Lohan Praise Jamie Lee Curtis on TODAY in 2004
summary: While appearing on TODAY in 2004, Lindsay Lohan spoke about her relationship with “Freaky Friday” co-star Jamie Lee Curtis.
story: Welcome inside the TODAY Vault, where we revisit memories from our show when celebrities and newsmakers started discourse, made us laugh or shaped our culture. This latest installment highlights Lindsay Lohan on TODAY on April 23, 2004, talking about her new film “Mean Girls,” as well as the success of “Freaky Friday,” which came out the year before.

At age 17, Lindsay Lohan was already a well-established star when she visited TODAY on April 23, 2004, plugging a little movie called “Mean Girls” that would go on to become a cultural phenomenon. While she was on hand to talk about that flick, she did take some time to gush about “Freaky Friday,” which had come out less than a year earlier on Aug. 6, 2003.

“Freaky Friday,” which also featured Jamie Lee Curtis, wound up earning more than $100 million and spurred a 2025 sequel. It also cemented Lohan’s place among the hottest young celebrities of the early and mid-2000s.
What Did Lindsay Lohan Say About Jamie Lee Curtis?

During her chat with Katie Couric, the former TODAY anchor ran down some of the films Lohan had made by that point in her career, including “The Parent Trap,” “Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen” and “Freaky Friday.”
“You got a lot of great reviews for ‘Freaky Friday,’ particularly,” Couric told her before asking if she enjoyed starring alongside Curtis in the hit film.
“I had a great time working with her,” she said. “She was so sweet. She’s really down to earth. She’s so much fun on set.”
Lindsay Lohan Looked at Jamie Lee Curtis As a Mentor
In Curtis, Lohan saw more than just a co-star — she saw someone who could guide her and share her wisdom.
“We talk all the time. She’s kind of like a second parent. It’s nice to have that. She’s really sweet,” Lohan said.
The two stars would continue their close friendship and admiration for each other over the years.
How Did Lindsay Lohan Launch an Acting Career?

Lohan was a show business veteran by the time she was on TODAY in 2004, but she was not that far removed from getting her start. She recounted working as a model when she was 5 before moving into acting.
“When I was, like, 7, I did my first commercial. I just started going out on commercials, just because I really enjoyed it, and I was comfortable in front of the cameras and stuff,” she said.
However, there was a point when Lohan was ready to give up.
“And I didn’t get anything. And I was like, ‘Mom, if I don’t get this commercial today, then I’m never doing this again.’ And I actually got that commercial that day.”
During her 2004 TODAY interview, she also touched on working on her music career.

title: Perez Hilton’s Family Confirms He ‘Is Able To Communicate’ After Reports He Livestreamed Self-Harm
summary: Perez Hilton’s family shared a statement after police responded to the celebrity blogger’s home in Miami following a livestream that was flagged in which he allegedly engaged in self-harm.
story: This story discusses self-harm. If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 988, or go to 988lifeline.org, to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. You can also call the network, previously known as the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline, at 800-273-8255, or visit SpeakingOfSuicide.com/resources.
Perez Hilton’s family is speaking out after police responded to the celebrity blogger’s home in Miami following a livestream in which he allegedly engaged in self-harm.
In the latest statement posted Aug. 5 on Hilton’s website, the blogger’s family and team shared an update.

“We have also been able to confirm that Perez is able to communicate, which has given our family hope,” they said in the statement. “We respectfully ask for your continued prayers, understanding, and grace as Perez continues to recover.”
The family also described the situation as “incredibly difficult and emotional.”

“This has been incredibly difficult and emotional for us, made even harder because very little information has been made available to our family,” they said in the statement. “While we continue to wait for further updates, we remain hopeful.”
Earlier that day, they had shared in a separate statement that Hilton was receiving medical care.

The updates comes after reports of “someone who was livestreaming acts of self-harm on social media” the night before, a Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office spokesperson told NBC News. The person was “safely recovered,” the sheriff’s office said. Police did not identify Hilton by name.

“Many of you have reached out with concern for Perez,” said the initial statement, signed “The Perez Hilton Team and Family.” “We are incredibly grateful for the overwhelming outpouring of love, support, and prayers.”
The family added that their “focus right now is on his well-being.”
“We kindly ask that you respect Perez’s privacy, as well as the privacy of his family, during this difficult time,” the statement said.

The livestream was posted to TikTok before the platform pulled the video. It appeared to show Hilton, covered in blood and holding a knife with signs of injuries. Concerned viewers commented on the livestream, asking for his contact information and offering to call for help.

According to a TikTok U.S. spokesperson, the social media platform’s automated moderator systems flagged the livestream within minutes. Then, the U.S. moderation team reviewed it and law enforcement was alerted.

The content violated the platform’s community guidelines, the spokesperson added. According to TikTok’s mental and behavioral health policies, the platform allows individuals to “discuss emotionally complex topics in a supportive way without increasing the risk of harm.”
“We don’t allow showing, promoting, or sharing plans for suicide or self-harm,” the guidelines say.

Footage from Hilton’s neighborhood, taken by NBC South Florida, showed multiple police vehicles in the area. Cameras from the local NBC affiliate showed paramedics transporting a man into an ambulance and driving away.
The police spokesperson said in a statement that family members of the individual that they recovered have been contacted.
“Deputies quickly located the individual’s residence, where they spoke with family members on scene, and confirmed he was alone inside,” the spokesperson said.

Hilton, who was born Mario Lavandeira, has three children — Mario III, Mia and Mayte Amor— all born via surrogacy. In a 2017 essay published on HuffPost, Hilton also mentioned that his mother lives with the family.
“Not many families are able to have that opportunity,” he wrote in the essay. “That difference makes us special and awesome, to me and us.”
In June, Hilton shared in a video that he and his family had moved back to Miami after a three-and-a-half-year-long stint in Las Vegas.
Hilton’s family and team said in their latest statement that they will continue to share updates “as we receive confirmed information and are able to do so.”
“Again, thank you, truly, for all your support and compassion,” the statement said. “We are so grateful.”

Chris Booker, who co-hosts “The Perez Hilton Podcast with Chris Booker” with the blogger, released a statement on Aug. 5 as well in response to the news. Booker said that he has only spoken “briefly” with Hilton’s family, who are struggling with getting updates themselves due to the security measures in place at the hospital. He reiterated that any official updates will appear on Hilton’s website.
“I am so profoundly sad for Perez and his family and what they’re all going through,” Booker said in the statement, shared on social media. “It’s truly unimaginable.”
Booker also said that the podcast is up in the air “as our collective focus is on his health.”
“I certainly hope to continue them with my friend when the time is right,” Booker wrote, adding that the support from fans has been “resounding.”
“He is very loved,” Booker wrote. “I can only hope that he feels it.”
Hilton’s agent Dante Rusciolelli, CEO and talent manager at Golden Arts Entertainment, also shared a statement on Aug. 5, asking the public to honor Hilton’s privacy as he receives care.
“At this time, we do not have any additional confirmed information to share regarding Perez Hilton’s condition,” the statement said.
Verified updates will come “directly from Dante Rusciolelli at Golden Artists Entertainment,” the statement said.

Hilton rose to fame in the early 2000s for his gossip blog, sounding off on celebrity drama. His commentary was often criticized as cyberbullying and labeled as “toxic.” However, Hilton attempted to turn a new leaf years later and embraced a gentler, softer version of himself.

“I’m aware of the fact there are going to be a lot of people with lingering resentment and a lot of skeptics,” he told the New York Times in a 2012 interview. “And that’s OK because I am not pretending to be perfect.”

title: ‘My Life With the Walter Boys’ Season 2 Recap: 7 Things to Remember Before Season 3
summary: Here’s what to remember before My Life with the Walter Boys returns for Season 3. Read a recap of Season 2.
story: The second season of “My Life with the Walter Boys” left viewers with two major cliffhangers. After a long year of waiting, fans are about to get the answers they’ve been craving when the hit Netflix series returns for Season 3 on Aug. 6.

Will Jackie (Nikki Rodriguez) and Alex (Ashby Gentry) be able to mend their relationship after she declared her love for Cole (Noah LaLonde)? Is George (Marc Blucas) going to survive his medical emergency? Viewers are ready to devour the 10 new episodes to find out.
Before Season 3 premieres, we’re recapping all the highlights from Season 2 so you can dive right in.
Jackie Returned to Colorado After Spending the Summer in New York City
At the end of Season 1, Jackie surprised the Walter family by leaving Colorado and returning to New York to live with her uncle, Richard (Alex Quijano).

Season 2 picked up with Jackie wrapping up a summer internship. It was a lonely couple of months for the teen since Richard was MIA and traveling a lot. Jackie no longer felt like she belonged in New York City, so she decided to attend boarding school in Vermont.

As Jackie’s legal guardian, Katherine (Sarah Rafferty) had to sign the paperwork for Jackie’s school transfer, and she wasn’t so sure that uprooting the teen once again was the right move. Luckily, Katherine visited Jackie in New York and convinced her to return to Colorado.

Back at the Walter ranch, Jackie got a lukewarm welcome. Several of the Walter siblings were upset that she left so suddenly a few months beforehand, but she quickly won them over and life began to return to normal.
Jackie’s Love Triangle with Alex and Cole Took a Brief Pause Then Got Messier Than Ever
At the end of Season 1, Jackie was dating Alex but also had undeniable chemistry with his brother Cole. In the Season 1 finale, Jackie and Cole ended up sharing a kiss, then she left town.
When she returned to Colorado at the beginning of Season 2, Jackie warned Cole that she hadn’t told Alex about their kiss and asked Cole to give her some space.

Alex was understandably frosty with Jackie when she returned, especially since she had blindsided him when she left town. Over time, he softened up and the two rekindled their romance. Due to their complicated history, they decided it was best to hide their relationship for a while. However, Cole caught the two kissing and  confronted Jackie in the season finale.

When Cole asked why Jackie and Alex got back together after breaking up, she defended their relationship. She also reminded Cole that they agreed to be just friends when she returned to town, despite the fact that they’d kissed. Cole responded by saying he was never just friends with Jackie.

Jackie explained that she was afraid of losing control with Cole since he makes her feel free. Cole responded by declaring his love for Jackie and she reciprocated his feelings. Unfortunately, Alex heard it all and he emerged from the darkness to ask Jackie if she really loves Cole.
Alex Became a Saddle Bronc Rider and Got a Riding Sponsorship

Much to the dismay of Katherine, Alex found a new hobby in Season 2: saddle bronc riding. His mom was understandably concerned that the sport is quite dangerous, but she arranged for him to get lessons with a rode trainer named Blake (Natalie Sharp). All of Alex’s hard work paid off since he ended up getting a sponsorship at the end of the season.
The Walters Faced Obstacles While Developing Their Ranch Expansion Project

In Season 1, the Walters came up with a plan to make their ranch more profitable with a new guest ranch business. In Season 2, Jackie’s uncle Richard was closely involved with the project as an investor.

Despite the family’s initial excitement about the ranch expansion, things started spiraling out of control as Richard became more involved. Will (Johnny Link) seemed to be eating up Richard’s ideas, even though his own father, George, was apprehensive about changing the ranch too much.

When many members of Silver Falls expressed concerns about the impact the ranch expansion would have on the community, the project was threatened. Soon enough, George and Katherine didn’t like the direction the project was going in and they wanted to back out. Richard had invested too much money into the project at this point, however, and threatened to cut George out of the project.

When George discovered that the ranch used to have a vineyard on it, he asked his friend to get in touch with a local winery. They agreed to lease the land to make immediate income and start paying back their investors. Will wasn’t happy but Richard was willing to listen to George’s idea.
George Had a Health Emergency

In the season finale, viewers were left with a cliffhanger in the last seconds when an ambulance showed up at the Walter house. Will also arrived and said, “It’s dad,” implying that his father had a health emergency.
Nathan Cheated on Skylar and They Broke Up
Nathan (Corey Fogelmanis) and Skylar (Jaylan Evans) were happily dating, but then Zach (Carson MacCormac), Skylar’s ex, came into the picture.
Zach started flirting heavily with Nathan and the two ended up kissing at a school dance. Skylar caught them and they broke up.

Zach and Nathan started dating and Nathan learned more about Zach’s history with Skylar. As it turns out, Skylar and Zach hooked up during their sophomore year, but Zach hadn’t publicly announced that he was gay yet. Skylar wanted to date someone who was openly gay so they went their separate ways.

Zach came out eventually, but by the time he did, Nathan and Skylar were already dating. So, Zach tried his best to lure Nathan away from Skylar to get Skylar’s attention, in the hopes that Skylar would ditch Nathan.

Eventually, Nathan and Zach broke up and Zach tried to get back with Skylar, but he had no interest. In the season finale, Nathan apologized to Skylar and they declared their love for each other. However, Skylar made it clear that he could no longer trust Nathan, even if he still loves him.
Two New Couples Emerged: Danny and Erin and Dylan and Kiley

Erin (Alisha Newton) previously dated Cole, but they had a pretty complicated relationship and he didn’t treat her very well. When Cole’s twin brother Danny (Connor Stanhope) starred in the school play with Erin in Season 1, sparks started to fly. The two kept in touch over summer break and started dating in Season 2.

Cole was pretty upset when he found out that his brother was dating his ex in secret, but eventually warmed up to their relationship. Danny and Erin seemed like the perfect match, but struggled to figure out how to maintain their relationship with college approaching.

Alex’s friend Kiley (Mya Lowe) found an unexpected new love interest in football player Dylan (Kolton Stewart). They had apparent chemistry throughout the season, but finally kissed in the season finale. Alex spotted them smooching and looked upset, despite the fact that he was happy with Jackie.

title: Karlie Kloss Loves to Answer This 1 Question: ‘What Does Karlie Have to Do With Tech?’
summary: Karlie Kloss talks to TODAY.com about her new children’s book, her passion for technology and why she thinks of Kode with Klossy as her “first baby.”
story: When the camera cuts, the interview isn’t over. With “Cut for Time,” TODAY.com asks the burning questions our anchors couldn’t get to on-air.

Karlie Kloss has had quite a busy summer, from attending the star-studded wedding of a certain blonde pop singer to turning 34. Kloss is also reaching new heights with the release of a children’s book, “Spaghetti Code: A Story About Problem-Solving, Pasta, and the Power of Big Ideas.”

“Spaghetti Code” follows a girl named Kelly Kent who embarks on a quest to untangle the messy process of building a pasta machine to save her local Italian restaurant. In the endnotes, Kloss gives a message to readers: “For the builders, the breakers, and the curious creators — the world is waiting for you! — K.K.”

Following her TODAY segment on July 28, Kloss, who shares 3 children with Joshua Kushner, sat down with TODAY.com to talk more about Kode With Klossy, the free girls’ summer coding program she started nearly 11 years ago. She also shared how she’s combatted imposter syndrome and doubt, the relationships she’s maintained with her early scholars and why she considers the venture her “first baby.”
This interview has been lightly edited for clarity.

I could have never dreamed that Kode With Klossy would grow into what it has become, and this community of scholars around the world would be what it is, which is more than 12,000 incredible young people. We have a few 1000 more in programs this summer, and it’s surreal. I feel like I’ve really grown up with these young women. One of the scholars texted me this morning. I’ve known her since she’s 14 years old, and now she is just thriving in the world, she’s a leader, she’s an entrepreneur. She was like, “We met at camp 10 years ago on the day,” and I was like, “What a crazy full circle moment.” I now have a daughter as well. And so, to think that when she’s 10 years old, Kode With Klossy will be 20 years old, is just wild to me.

Oh my gosh, so much. And I think that’s the thing. Listen, I started working in my career at 15 years old. Just because you’re a young person doesn’t mean that you’re not extremely capable and curious. What we really aim to do is provide access to tools and skills that can build confidence in individuals. And that’s really what Kode With Klossy has always been about, and this book is sort of an opportunity to reach a younger audience with that same idea, of how we can sort of demystify something that can be really intimidating, coding and technology, but help young girls and young people see themselves in these spaces, and that I think is so important.

I think imposter syndrome is something that I’ve certainly experienced in different chapters of my life, but I think that’s part of why I started Kode With Klossy, and I think that’s part of why it has resonated. I am not an extremely educated person who’s worked in technology in this tech industry for my whole career. But that does not mean that I am not curious about these skills and tools. When I started this organization, people were definitely kind of confused. They were like, “What does Karlie have to do with tech?” But the truth is that I want everyone to realize that this is something we all can learn, and I think it’s important whether you want to work in the technology industry or not. It’s important to be informed how technology works as a consumer, as a citizen. So I think it’s important that people realize you don’t have to have a PhD in computer science to find value in understanding this.

We’ve had AI literacy for four years in our programs, and it’s been a central conversation all the way through. I really want young people to understand what is happening and understand these tools and not be intimidated by them, but to question it and to use it responsibly.

title: Al Roker Comes Face-to-Face with His ‘Twin’ on the TODAY Plaza: ‘That’s Freaky’
summary: Al Roker had to do a double take when he came face to face with his doppelgänger this morning.
story: Al Roker had to do a double take when he came face to face with his doppelgänger this morning.

The moment occurred Aug. 6 while the TODAY weatherman was visiting with fans on the TODAY Plaza. As he was doing a live segment, Al paused to speak with one special couple who brought a sign that caught his eye.
“I feel badly for this woman over here because it said she’s married to Al Roker’s twin,” Al said as he walked over to the couple, Shirley and Percy.
On their sign, the couple included a photo of themselves alongside Al with the text, “I’m married to Al Roker’s twin.”
They weren’t lying. Wearing a baseball cap and glasses, Percy resembles the beloved meteorologist so much, Al himself called it “freaky.”
Speaking to the couple on-air, Al self-deprecatingly joked, “How horrible is that?” while referencing Shirley’s sign.
Shirley laughed and said, “It’s not bad.”
Al was curious if people ever tell Percy he resembles the TODAY weatherman.
“A lot of people,” Percy said.
Before continuing with his scheduled weather segment, Al said, “OK, well listen, I hope it’s been as wonderful as it appears to be.”
“Wow, that’s freaky,” Al added as he walked to join his co-hosts.

Other members of the TODAY team have reflected on their own potential doppelgängers. Former co-anchor and “Making Space” host Hoda Kotb has long said she often gets mistaken for fellow broadcast journalist Gayle King. Meanwhile Saturday TODAY’s Laura Jarrett has said people name Meghan Markle among her look-alikes.

title: Role Model Surprises TODAY by Crashing Al Roker’s Weather Segment
summary: Role Model crashed Al Roker’s weather segment during an appearance on TODAY on August 6 ahead of the release of his third album.
story: Al Roker got a little help reporting the weather from a special guest this morning.
Role Model stopped by Studio 1A to lend a hand to the TODAY weatherman and give a look at the forecast across the country for Aug. 6.
To celebrate the release of the singer’s third album “Chuck Timely & The Hourglass,” which is out on Aug. 7, Al selected some special cities to highlight on the weather map.
In a play on the album title, the duo put a spotlight on the forecast in Charles City, Iowa. They also paid tribute to Role Model’s song “Joy” by highlighting the weather in Joy, Texas.
“Just like the song, it’s going to be very hot, very spicy (in Joy, Texas),” the singer said.
Moving through the map, Al and Role Model made a reference to the singer’s hit “Chasing Midnight” as they made their way to the forecast for Midnight, Mississippi.
The musician’s song “Love I You” inspired one other city on the map — Love, Arizona — as did the song “Honeydew,” which got some love with the addition of Honeydew, California on the map.
Last, but certainly not least, Al added Harmony, Maine to the map in a nod to Role Model’s song “Harmony” and his home state of Maine, which he called his “favorite area” of the map.
This isn’t the first time Al and Role Model have teamed up on air. In 2025, they collaborated for a showstopping moment during the singer’s Citi Concert Series performance.
Role Model, whose real name is Tucker Pillsbury, performed his hit “Sally, When the Wine Runs Out.”
During the song, which has become a staple at Role Model’s concerts, the singer typically invites a fan to dance with him on stage and calls them “Sally.”

Al was happy to volunteer for the assignment during the Citi Concert series and hit the stage wearing a cowboy hat and holding a wine glass. The duo left fans grinning as they sang and danced together.

Role Model has had a plethora of fans volunteer to be “Sally” during his concerts. But as he was sharing the Aug. 6 forecast with the singer, Al was curious to know if one of them stands out more than the others.
“You were my favorite,” Role Model said.

title: Alison Espach Shares if She’d Ever Write a ‘Wedding People’ Sequel
summary: Alison Espach shares if she’d ever write a Wedding People sequel amid the book being a bestselling hit after two years of publication.
story: Alison Espach’s novel “The Wedding People” was a bestselling hit, a BookTok craze and a Read With Jenna pick.

“It’s about where we are when we’re in the middle of our life and expectations versus reality. It’s about love and friendship and finding that love when you least expect it,” Jenna Bush Hager said when the book first came out.
“I think you will love this book if you want to laugh, maybe shed a couple tears, but also just have a lot of fun.”
The novel covers difficult topics such as suicide and grief, but also incorporates comedy and unexpected connections. Since its debut in July 2024, the book has sold over 1.5 million copies.
When Espach joined Jenna for the Aug. 6 episode of her “Open Book With Jenna” podcast, the TODAY host asked a question top of mind for many “Wedding People” fans: “Will there ever be a sequel?”
And Espach didn’t say no.
“It’s funny, it never occurred to me to write a sequel until people started asking, and then I was like, ‘Oh, I could see that,’ so I’m not saying no,” the author told Jenna.
“I’m not going to take that as a yes, either,” Jenna wearily responded.
“Oh, it’s definitely like, ‘Who knows,’” Espach agreed. But, she added, it’s the “only book” where she hasn’t felt “entirely” sick of the characters by the end of writing it.
To her, that’s a good sign.

“By the time you publish a book, you’re usually sick of it, and you have to relearn to love it again. And I sort of missed (’The Wedding People’ characters) when I was done,” she said. “I don’t feel sick of them.”
But, she added, if a sequel does arrive, “It’ll be a while.”
“I’ll probably write the sequel when no one cares anymore,” she joked. Pretending to be her readers on release day, she added, “‘We’ve moved on, it’s been 35 years.’”

title: Melanie C Explains Why Victoria Beckham Didn’t Attend Her Wedding
summary: Melanie “Mel C” Chisholm is addressing why her longtime friend and former Spice Girl member Victoria Beckham wasn’t present at her wedding.
story: Melanie “Mel C” Chisholm is addressing why her longtime friend and former Spice Girl member Victoria Beckham wasn’t present at her wedding.

The singer, known as Sporty Spice, married model and actor Chris Dingwall in July, sharing video of their special day with British Vogue. Chisholm also posted photos from their nuptials, as well as the wedding guests on her Instagram on Aug. 2.

Among the friends who attended the nuptials were fellow Spice Girls Geri Halliwell-Horner, Emma Bunton and Melanie “Mel B” Brown. While Chisholm thanked Beckham in her Instagram caption for designing her “beautiful dress,” the singer-turned-fashion designer was nowhere in sight.
During an interview on Australian radio station KIIS 1065, the hosts congratulated her on her wedding, before asking why Posh Spice was missing.

“So, Victoria was very disappointed to not be there. She was with David (Beckham) in New York and it was the football final, the World Cup,” she said. “She tried to get out of it. She isn’t the biggest football fan, she won’t mind me telling you. But the family were there and David had commitments being an ambassador for FIFA.”
She added that while she wasn’t in attendance, she designed her “gorgeous dress.”
“And she was messaging me on the day, and I actually saw her when I was in Ibiza. So we had a little catch up,” Chisholm added. “So yeah, we were giving her updates and sending her pictures.”

Victoria and David Beckham attended a number of FIFA World Cup matches, spotted in Los Angeles, Miami and the July 19 final at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. During the final match, the couple were accompanied by their sons Cruz and Romeo Beckham.
Chisholm, meanwhile, described her wedding as “amazing” and “perfect.”
“My feet haven’t touched the ground, really, because we had a beautiful weekend with all our families and friends,” she said.

She also shared that “there were several Spice Girls songs” played during her wedding. In another separate interview with Australia’s “The Smallzy Show,” she said that she “walked back up the aisle with my husband to ‘2 Become 1,’ played by a beautiful string quartet.”
Additionally in her chat with KIIS 1065, the newlywed also addressed Halliwell-Horner wearing a white floral dress to her wedding.

Chisholm said she did have a chat with her friend “because it is her favorite color, she wears it every day ... but she did have a beautiful floral dress on and it was white. But I did have a little giggle with her about that.”

title: Andy Cohen Politely Reviews Craig’s Attempts at His ‘Real Housewives’ Tagline: ‘Good Starting Point’
summary: TODAY’s Craig Melvin attempted an updated “Real Housewives”-style tagline about himself, and Andy Cohen gave an honest review.
story: TODAY’s Craig Melvin still may not be “Real Housewives” ready.

A hallmark of the 20-year franchise are the taglines cast members say in each show’s intro. Lisa Vanderpump of “Beverly Hills” famously said, “Life isn’t all diamonds and rosé, but it should be,” while “Atlanta’s” Phaedra Parks opted for, “Only God can judge me, and he seems quite impressed.”
In 2022, the TODAY hosts put their own spin on the taglines with “The Real Anchors of TODAY,” which Craig Melvin and Bravo executive producer Andy Cohen revisited in Studio 1A on Aug. 5.
“As a journalist, I usually keep one ear to the ground, because I’m getting the other one pierced,” Craig said at the time, which Cohen gave a “so-so” rating.
Now, Craig’s craving redemption.
“It was mediocre,” he said. “I wanted to try again.”
As the franchise’s unmistakable soundtrack played in the studio, Craig gave it another shot.
“I may spill the tea, but I still keep the glass half full,” he said, a pun on the video podcast he launched in March 2026.
“That’s good ... yes,” Cohen responded.
But Craig wasn’t done.
“Growing up in the South, I was raised to mind my manners, not my business,” he said.
Cohen was less impressed.
“Alright, I’m lost,” Cohen responded with a head shake.
“You’re always honest,” Craig said, before giving it one more go.
“I’m in the business of news, but I’m never above a little drama,” he said.
“That’s a good starting place, we’ll work on that,” Cohen determined.
“I couldn’t be a real housewife,” Craig said with a laugh.
Of the three, Cohen said his favorite was Craig’s first attempt.
“It’s where you’re at on the TODAY show right now,” Cohen said.

Cohen is fittingly looking back at his own television career, celebrating the 20th anniversary of the “Real Housewives” franchise, which he’s led since it launched in 2006 with “The Real Housewives of Orange County.” To mark the milestone, Bravo will release “Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th,” which premieres Aug. 9.
But Cohen has no intention of slowing down.
“I want to keep this going as long as I can,” Cohen said. “I got kids to feed.”

title: Harry Jowsey Is in the ‘Best Place’ He’s Ever Been After ‘Let’s Marry Harry’
summary: Harry Jowsey speaks to TODAY.com about his new show, Let’s Marry Harry, and why he’s int he best place he’s ever been ahead of the show’s finale.
story: When the camera cuts, the interview isn’t over. With “Cut for Time,” TODAY.com asks the burning questions our anchors couldn’t get to on-air.

Harry Jowsey has flirted his way across the Netflix dating show universe, from his “Too Hot to Handle” debut to his “Perfect Match” antics. But in his new series, “Let’s Marry Harry,” he’s going all in to find his forever beau.
With “Let’s Marry Harry” production behind him, Harry tells TODAY.com, “It was perfect.”
“I’m in the best place I’ve ever been,” he says.

Across the eight-episode season, the 29-year-old reality dating vet pursues 20 hopeful women, each sporting an engagement ring and vying for his hand in marriage — and the approval of his hand-picked matchmaking squad.

Jowsey’s friends Amanda Kloots, Sonny Henty and ex-girlfriend Georgia Hassarati of “Too Hot to Handle” all pulled strings behind the scenes, making calls like who gets dates, who gets cut and who gets a step closer to the altar. Executive producer and “Call Her Daddy” host Alex Cooper also joined to advise Jowsey as drama reached its boiling point.
Jowsey joined TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Willie Geist to discuss the show on Aug. 5, its premiere date. The final episode premieres Aug. 12.

Discussing his evolution from his reality debut to now, Jowsey said, “I feel like that guy back then didn’t really care too much about anyone else’s feelings. I was a class clown, I was going to do whatever I wanted.”
But for “Let’s Marry Harry,” he joked, he’s “figured out empathy and thoughts.”

After chatting with Jenna and Willie, Jowsey stuck around to break the rest down for TODAY.com: opening up to commitment, dating on and off screen and the self-help steps that got him ready to say “I do.”
This interview has been lightly edited for clarity.

After losing my dad, it was really a pivotal moment in my life. Seeing my sisters with their husbands and kids, and just knowing that I really wish I had that for my dad. Coming back to LA and not having a good support system, I was like, I’ve really got to be serious about love.
I kept asking for a sign, and they kept showing up. It was good.

Leading into it, it didn’t really cross my mind until the first day, and then I was like, “Oh my God, this is really scary.” I think the first fear, or thought throughout, I was just more upset about hurting people because I don’t want to be that guy anymore, and I don’t want to break anyone’s hearts. And obviously, it’s difficult, because that’s kind of a big thing that happens on dating shows. So I think that was my biggest fear going through the whole thing, I don’t want to break someone’s heart.

There was so much different. I was reading a bunch of self-help books, and then Amanda Kloots sat me down for four and a half hours before it, just quizzing everything about my dating life and making sure I was ready. I also knew if I didn’t take it serious and if I was playing around and being a silly sausage, it wouldn’t be good for anyone, and it would really suck. Netflix put all this like money into it and love into it, and I just wanted to make sure I was doing it as best I could.
“He’s Scared, She’s Scared.” It’s this book about self sabotage. I was trying to figure out if I do that a lot, but I think I’m all good now.

All the girls just made it such a safe space. I think I was more upset when they had to hand the rings back. I know a lot of them got quite attached to them. I was just really appreciative because they all were just so warm and made it safe.

I think so. I think dating these days is so difficult, regardless of any of the silly stuff I’ve done. But I feel like it’s helped me become just a way better version of myself because with all those lows, you know you can only come back up, and I’m just grateful I was able to learn from my mistakes.
Yeah, it was perfect. And I’m in the the best place I’ve ever been, so I’m really happy.

I realized I’ve been quite easy to be dismissive and avoidant in the past. Being in an environment like that where you just have to face everything head-on, because if you don’t, then you’re not going to get what you want to show, and also you’re not going to deal with the problem. So it really made me be way better at communicating and also dealing with 20 different personalities at once and learning about that and looking within a lot, which was quite fascinating.
I feel like more now, but leading into the show, I was like, ‘I’m cooked.’ That’s why they had to bring my friends in because I’m spiraling. But yeah, now I trust my thoughts and feelings.

I think I was more nervous for her. It’s such a brave thing to do, and to be like, OK, I’m willing to be a part of this and help an ex when we’ve had quite a colorful past together. I was really grateful that she wanted to do it.
I think “Too Hot to Handle” Harry should have never been in a relationship. He should have just had fun and lived in the moment. I feel like now it’s one person, forever locked in.

title: Will There Be a Season 2 of ‘Sterling Point?’ What Star Ella Rubin Hopes to See
summary: What happens at the end of Prime Video’s “Sterling Point”? Ella Rubin unpacks the twist and shares her Season 2 hopes.
story: In the post-“Summer I Turned Pretty” and “Off Campus” television landscape, “Sterling Point” is the latest to join the ranks of Prime Video teen dramas.

Season 1 of “Sterling Point,” which released Aug. 5, has all the key ingredients: a slow-burn love triangle, beautiful on-location setting, a trendy soundtrack and an ensemble cast of up-and-coming young actors — including leading lady Ella Rubin, who previously supported movies like “The Idea of You” and “Anora.”

“Sterling Point,” created by Megan Park, is an original series that follows city-girl Annie Jacobson after learning she has secret ties to Canada. Annie’s adoptive mother died when she was young, and her father has told her little about her mother’s family.

After her estranged grandfather’s death, Annie heads to his home on Sterling Point, an island off Lake Muskoka in Canada, giving her more questions than answers — at first — and a new outlook on what it means to grow up.
Here’s what to know about the ending of “Sterling Point,” including that plot twist within a plot twist, and what it means for a potential second season.
Warning: Spoilers from “Sterling Point” below.
What Happens in ‘Sterling Point’?
Audiences are right alongside Annie as she uncovers the lies she and her newfound extended family have been told.
After finding letters from her grandfather, previously hidden by her dad, Steven (Jay Duplass), Annie learns about her ties to Canada.

Shortly after arriving in Lake Muskoka, Annie, who was told growing up her parents couldn’t conceive, learns her mother had a biological daughter roughly two years after adopting Annie and her twin brother, Connor.

Ramona was raised by their grandfather in Canada and spent her summers on Sterling Point, which all three siblings will now inherit. Annie and Ramona go from painfully co-existing to forming a deep bond through their separate-but-shared mysterious childhoods.

Together, they learn that Annie and Ramona’s mother grew up coming to the island as a child and had an on-and-off relationship with a man named Joe (Jeffrey Dean Morgan). After adopting Annie and Connor, their mom got pregnant, though her husband Steven was said to be infertile.

It’s revealed she planned to leave Steven, stay on the island to raise Connor, Annie and baby-on-the-way Ramona, and finally be with Joe. She returned to Sterling Point to give birth to Ramona but died in labor because of a previously unknown heart condition.
But after her death, Steven took Annie and Connor back to New York City and concealed their Sterling Point lineage.

The show had one more twist. After learning about her mom and Joe’s affair, Ramona assumed Joe was her father. Then she learns Steven is colorblind, like herself. Because colorblindness is genetic, Ramona makes Steven take a paternity test, revealing he’s also her biological father.
As Annie falls more and more in love with Lake Muskoka, Ramona becomes interested in getting to know Steven.
Where Does the First Season Leave Annie and Ramona?

After a long debate, Annie and Ramona decide to switch places. Annie stays in Sterling Point, and Ramona goes to the city to get a new vantage point. In the final scene, Ramona wake up in Annie’s room in Brooklyn, and Annie in Ramona’s.
“I loved the ‘Parent Trap’-esque ending, and I thought it was that perfect kind of ambiguous, yet satisfying closing loop to the first season,” Rubin tells TODAY.com.
Will There Be a ‘Sterling Point’ Season 2?
Rubin is hoping for a second season to return as Annie.
“Sterling Point” has not been officially renewed for a second season. Park, who wrote and directed the series, has spoken about the possibility of expanding beyond an eight-episode debut.
Rubin shares what she could envision for Annie in the future.

“I don’t know what I can tease, not because it’s a secret, but because there’s so many amazing routes that Annie’s journey can take,” Rubin tells TODAY.com. “I truly don’t know what’s going to happen. And that’s both exciting and nerve-racking because, she feels like someone who’s almost become a sort of friend of mine.
“I don’t know what she’s up to right now, but I hope that she and Ramona are happy with their choices, and also that it leads to some more, you know, fun conflict,” Rubin adds with a laugh.

title: Ella Rubin Channeled These Early 2000s Ballads For Starring Role in Teen Drama ‘Sterling Point’
summary: Ella Rubin unpacks her starring role in Prime Video’s “Sterling Point” and shares how she journaled and listened to music to get into character as Annie.
story: When the camera cuts, the interview isn’t over. With “Cut for Time,” TODAY.com asks the burning questions our anchors couldn’t get to on-air.

In Prime Video’s new teen drama series, “Sterling Point,” Ella Rubin’s Annie Jacobson leaves the comforts of city life for Lake Muskoka, Canada, and encounters an unexpected reunion with both old and new friends.
The same can be said for Rubin herself, who is making her debut as a leading lady.

Like Annie, Rubin is a born-and-raised New Yorker, and, like Annie, the 24-year-old went to Canada and had an “out-of-body experience,” processing what it means to grow from supporting roles in “Anora,” “The Idea of You” and the “Gossip Girl” reboot into a new phase of her career.

“Sterling Point,” created by Megan Park with executive producers Joshua Schwartz and Stephanie Savage of “Gossip Girl” and the “The O.C.,” is a twisty family mystery with an ensemble of wily, messy teens.

It opens with Rubin’s Annie and her twin brother, played by Keen Ruffalo (son of Mark Ruffalo), learning of their estranged grandfather’s death. His will reveals he left them an island, Sterling Point, located off Canada’s Lake Muskoka. (“Mom was Canadian?” Rubin’s character asks in Episode 1.)

“It kind of unravels her life in this dramatic, funny, beautiful, sad way,” Rubin said of the show while appearing on TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle Aug. 3. “She discovers a lot of secrets that were kept from her, and also a lot of secrets she kind of kept from herself.

“And of course there’s romance and sisterhood and friendship, and it’s really a fun, funny series, but also I think it doesn’t shy away from emotion and tenderness, and it’s a refreshingly tender show,” she adds.

Speaking with TODAY.com after her live interview, Rubin dives into her process finding Annie, unpacks the unscripted moments that made the final cut and pitches why “Sterling Point” stands out among today’s teen drama shows.
This interview has been lightly edited for clarity.

There was a lot more trust, a lot more creative agency. And also just a bigger responsibility in the sense that I wanted to be a good leader in certain ways, and take the responsibilities seriously, of getting to be so lucky to be in a show like this. I just wanted to take it very seriously and kind of take all that I’d learned in the years of doing it here and there and create a fun, healthy, productive environment.

It felt so, so cool. It was really incredible wish fulfillment. They’re just legends, and so I knew I was in really great hands. And then also, five years after doing a job where I was really nervous and unsure, I just felt so lucky to be entrusted in this new way. It was just the coolest out-of-body experience. And also, they’re both really great people.
It just feels really cool to be old enough to have been doing this long enough that I can reunite with someone. It also was a trip in that sense, in the best way.

I think something really special about “Sterling Point” is the grounded-ness, and I think the brilliance of combining Josh and Steph and Megan Park is that there’s a propulsive plot, and it’s a teen drama, and it’s coming of age, but then it also has really real language. It’s very grounded. There’s a lot of genuine emotion. There’s a lot of messiness, and I think we allow the characters to be imperfect, and the show is really, really tender.

Especially with being young women in a show, allowing them to not always be perfectly likable is a really special thing. It explores really intense themes, and it balances dark and light in a beautiful way. There is a lot of grief, and there’s trauma, and then there’s also a lot of friendship and first love and romance and excitement.
Can I tell you something funny about that? That was not planned!

I think something I really, really loved about filming this show is that Megan encouraged constant improvisation, changes, sort of flowing with where the scene took us, which is a really rare gift. When moments like that happen, we just get to fully lean into it and enjoy the kind of spontaneity and ridiculousness of real life, because, like, what’s better than that?
So, essentially, the seaplane took off. That happened, and I just rocked with it and was crossing my fingers that they would use it, because I loved that moment so much.

I loved doing the boating scenes. They’re probably my favorite memories from filming. First of all, I really found a knack for boating, and I shockingly just loved it and felt really comfortable, and I was in my element randomly, even though I’m a born and bred city kid.

We would do lessons, and so once I learned how to operate these boats, they kind of just sent me out. I have a little makeup kit and mirror to do touchups on myself. And then they’d scream “Action!” from another boat, and then I get to just feel really free. It was very organic, filming those scenes, because you can’t really see a camera. You’re not really being touched. You’re just out in the open, and then also, not only that, you get to be in nature all day. You’re literally sitting in the water, breathing in the air, and feeling the trees, and it was just really, really special, and it allowed me to kind of get into Annie’s headspace of becoming, in a way, one with nature.

The needle drops of this series are awesome. I’m so glad that you felt that way as well. Journaling was a huge thing for me. I had an Annie notebook that became sort of a bible to me in ways. Music was huge for me in this process, too, and I had a very extensive Annie playlist. Some of it was music she would listen to, some of it was music I would listen to get into her character, and some of it was music that was kind of indicative of what she was experiencing, or certain songs for certain characters, dedicated to certain romance storylines, but music was probably one of my primary forms of preparation.

I love this question. The Chicks, particularly “Wide Open Spaces.” I think it’s perfectly descriptive of Annie’s experience. Funny enough, there were a lot of 2000s ballads. “I‘m With You” by Avril Lavigne made a few appearances. “I’m On Fire” by Bruce Springsteen. “Wildflowers” by Tom Petty. There was a feeling in “Sterling Point” that’s like cozy, early 2000s and kind of has that energy, and I just thought that those songs really brought me into that in a really amazing way. Oh, and “Wish That You Were Here” by Florence and The Machine was a big one for Annie’s mom.

title: Andy Cohen Reveals His New Boyfriend Has Never Seen ‘Housewives’: ‘Not 1 Frame’
summary: Andy Cohen’s boyfriend has a lot to learn about the Bravo-verse and all the “Housewives” that are part of it.
story: Andy Cohen’s boyfriend has a lot to learn about the Bravo-verse and all the “Housewives” that are part of it.
The longtime Bravo producer and “Watch What Happens Live” host shared details about his relationship with businessman Kevin Sobieski after the two went public in June.

In an Aug. 5 appearance on TODAY, Cohen came to celebrate 20 years of “Real Housewives” on Bravo and spoke with Craig Melvin about “The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th,” which brings together iconic women across the franchises.
While chatting with Cohen, Craig asked what Sobieski thinks about the long-running reality shows that Cohen created.
“Is he a ‘Real Housewives’ kind of guy? Craig asked.
“Never seen it,” Cohen replied.
“Not one frame?” Craig asked.
“Yes. (He not seen one frame,” Cohen confirmed.
Still, if social media has anything to say about it, Cohen’s beau will be up to speed in no time.
“His algorithm is feeding him ‘Housewives’-related things because our phones listen to everything we say. So he’s starting to, I think, get a sense of the universe. But he has no clue,” Cohen said.
“Does that not bother you at all?” Craig asked.
“No, not at all. I love it. He loves my kids and me, and that’s what’s important,” Cohen said. “But I’ll get him there.”
During a June episode of his “Andy Cohen Live” Sirius XM podcast, Cohen shared that he’d “met the person.”
“This man is kind, and strong, and smart, and he is an adult,” Cohen said. “And he loves my children, and they love him, and I love him.”
Cohen also revealed that he met his boyfriend at a mutual friend’s July Fourth party in 2025.

“We talked all night,” he said. “I very methodically put my number in his phone. Apparently, I said to him twice that night, ‘I want to make sure this number is right. … And then he said, ‘Wow, I knew you were serious when you were really, like, serious about this number.’”
The Bravo star said he took a “slow and deliberate and methodical” approach to dating his boyfriend and introducing him to his two children, Ben and Lucy.
“It has been so easy. One year later, I still can’t believe I found him.”

title: Carson Daly Clarifies He’s Still Hosting ‘The Voice’ After Spinoff Is Announced
summary: Carson Daly has no plans to leave “The Voice,” he confirms. He is not leaving The Voice but will continue to host The Voice.
story: After 30 seasons of hosting “The Voice,” Carson Daly has no plans of walking away from the reality singing competition anytime soon.

On Aug. 4, NBC announced a spinoff version of the show, titled “The Voice: Celebrity.” Set to debut in 2027, the series will feature Keke Palmer as a host and will challenge celebrities to compete for the opportunity to become the first “Voice” celebrity champion.
After the new show was announced, some fans began to wonder if it would replace the original series, leaving many to question what that meant for Carson.
The TODAY host quickly addressed the speculation in an Instagram shared on Aug. 4, clarifying that he would remain in his hosting role as “The Voice” enters Season 31.

“‘Celeb Voice’ is a fun, NEW IDEA that features some big differences like… FAMOUS PEOPLE singing for 3 coaches to see if they have what it takes. There’s lots of new twists & turns. I have been talking about it on @todayshow for a while now. I am not the right host for it. We have a NEW amazing HOST! The triple threat queen @keke who is PERFECT for it! I’m so grateful she carved out the time in her busy career to help us out. 🙏We’re all big fans & welcome her to the family,” he wrote.
Carson continued his post, addressing the rumors that he is no longer involved with the show head-on.

“Many today have asked if I’m leaving the show. Nope. We’re gonna try out these 2 formats this fall/spring & see how it goes! Hopefully this post clears up any confusion. I am still hosting the show currently. In fact, I have hosted & produced every single second of the show since day 1, 30 seasons. 16 years,” he wrote.
Carson said he will be directly involved with “The Voice: Celebrity” “from behind the scenes” and will be producing the series.
Carson ended his post by sharing an update on the upcoming season of “The Voice,” which premieres Sept. 21.

“Meanwhile, thanks for watching any/all Voice shows & we can’t wait to see you NEXT MONTH with the ‘OG’ Voice coaches @adamlevine @kellyclarkson @queenlatifah @rileyduckman & yes, me. We’ve already shot a-lot of it & it may be our best season yet!! And please tune in SPRING 2027 for Celebrity Voice! 🎤🏆,” he wrote.
When “The Voice: Celebrity” premieres in 2027, it will feature several celebrity coaches, including Joe Jonas, Queen Latifah and Riley Green.

title: Viral TV Anchor Who Fell Asleep on Air Recounts How a Night with a Teething 8-Month-Old Led to ‘Work Nightmare’
summary: Memphis news anchor Dominique Dillon spoke to TODAY about falling asleep on air and how a night up with her 8 month old led to the moment.
story: As local morning news anchor Dominique Dillon realized she had been dozing off during a live broadcast, it felt like a bad dream.

“I opened my eyes, and it was cutting to the next shot and I was like, ‘Oh my goodness, I can’t believe this just happened to me,’” Dillon told Craig Melvin and Laura Jarrett in a TODAY exclusive on Aug. 5.
“I am mortified. I was pinching myself under the desk like, ‘This has to be a nightmare.’ Like one of those work nightmares, because this is not my life right now.”

However, the reaction to the viral clip from late July has been a dream for the FOX13 Memphis anchor. The mom of 2-year-old daughter Dakota and 8-month-old daughter Delilah said she has received an “overwhelmingly” positive reaction from viewers who can relate to a parent of young children running on fumes.

Dillon shared the backstory on TODAY about why she was so sleepy during the broadcast. The viral clip shows Dillon dozing with her eyes closed and head resting on her hands in the studio while on air with a reporter on location.
The night before the viral moment, her husband had been working a double shift at BNSF Railway while she tried to put her two girls to bed.

“I was trying to get them down to sleep at 8 o’clock, but my 8-month-old, she wasn’t having it,” Dillon said. “She was teething, and I just couldn’t console her. I gave her some teething medicine and nothing was working. The next thing you know it’s 10:30, 11 o’clock before I can get actually get her down to sleep. Then all I have is a couple hours of rest before I have to be up in the morning and be at work.”

Dillon normally wakes up at 1:30 a.m. to start preparing for her early morning anchor shift from 4:30 to 5 a.m. Working on short rest, she drifted off into a mini nap live on air before her colleague, Fox 13 meteorologist Brittani DuBose, whispered her name from across the room to try to snap her out of it.
The doze happened so quickly it even took the producers by surprise.

“They’re there, but they didn’t think I was sleeping,” Dillon said on TODAY. “They thought I was simply looking down at my tablet, because who falls asleep in one minute, sitting up, in front of cameras?”

Dillon, who welcomed her second child in December, went on to poke fun at the moment. Her colleague and FOX13 Good Morning Memphis anchor Ernie Freeman shared a selfie of himself with Dillon, who was pretending to nap.
“Now that ‘The Big Show’ is over, it’s time for Dominique Dillon to catch another nap,” he wrote on Facebook.
Dillon reposted the photo on Facebook on July 29, adding, “Couldn’t even give me a nudge. Brittani DuBose FOX13 had my back though!”
“Those morning shifts are so challenging. Let’s give her some grace and support,” one person commented on the Instagram video.

“Well we understand she has a little one at the house so her nights are different right now,” another commented on Dillon’s post, while another added, “I used to want to catch a nap at a stoplight when I was in baby mode. All mamas can relate.”
Dillon was grateful for the positive support considering how ugly the internet can get after a viral moment like that.

“It’s not always a nice place, and what I love so much about this situation is that it shows the good side of humanity and that people understand what I’m going through as a mother,” she said on TODAY. “There’s so many mothers out there and parents in general who work hard. They show up to work, they give 100% and then they go home and that’s like a whole ‘nother full-time job as well, and they’re giving 100% to their families.”
The California native started in news in 2017 and worked in Texas and Louisiana before joining the station in Memphis in 2019.
The day after her little mid-morning snooze, she shared a photo an inspirational quote on Facebook.

“‘Every morning, you have two choices: continue to sleep with your dreams or wake up and chase them,’ — Arnold Schwarzenegger. Wise words from my former Governor,” the California native wrote, adding, “Good morning!”
She wants other hard-working parents to know she is in their corner after all the support she has received.

“I just want parents to know that you’re doing a great job, and keep it up,” she said on TODAY. “And to the mothers out there, those long nights, they’re worth it. Continue to show up to work, give your best and then also come home and give your best to your children as well because all they want is for their parents to show up and be there for them.”

title: ‘The Voice’ Gets ‘Celebrity’ Spinoff With New Coaches, Host and Format
summary: “The Voice” is switching things up again!
story: “The Voice” is switching things up again!
Following Season 29’s “The Voice: Battle of Champions,” it appears the NBC singing competition is undergoing another makeover for 2027.

On Aug. 4, it was revealed that NBC has started production for “The Voice: Celebrity,” where stars ranging from actors, musicians, influencers and more will compete to become the first “Voice” celebrity champion.
“The Voice: Celebrity” will feature new and returning coaches, as well as a new host.
